properties.name: logchi.enabled
properties.description: Turns logchi on or off.

properties.name: logchi.dir
properties.description: Directory for log files.

properties.name: logchi.app-name
properties.description: First part of file names. Defaults to spring.application.name.

properties.name: logchi.instance-id
properties.description: Identifies this process in file names. Defaults to HOSTNAME, then the machine name.

properties.name: logchi.stack-trace-lines
properties.description: Frames kept per exception. Causes are always kept. 0 means no limit.

properties.name: logchi.multiline-loggers
properties.description: Loggers whose messages keep their line breaks in text output. Continuation lines are indented with a tab. Applies to loggers below these names too.

properties.name: logchi.console.enabled
properties.description: Replaces the console output with logchi's. False removes console output.

properties.name: logchi.console.format
properties.description: text or json.

properties.name: logchi.console.color
properties.description: auto, always or never.

properties.name: logchi.file.enabled
properties.description: Writes log files.

properties.name: logchi.file.format
properties.description: text or json.

properties.name: logchi.file.json-flavor
properties.description: Field names used by the json format: ecs, logstash or compact.

properties.name: logchi.file.extension
properties.description: Log file extension.

properties.name: logchi.file.permissions
properties.description: Permissions for log files, such as 640 or rw-r-----. The log folder gets the matching search bits. Empty leaves it to the process umask.

properties.name: logchi.file.rotation.period
properties.description: hourly, daily or none.

properties.name: logchi.file.rotation.max-size
properties.description: Rolls the file at this size. 0 means no limit.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.hot
properties.description: Age since last write at which a rolled file is compressed.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.cold
properties.description: Age since last write at which a rolled file is deleted.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.compress
properties.description: Compresses rolled files with gzip.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.compress-level
properties.description: Gzip level from 1 (fastest) to 9 (smallest).

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.max-total
properties.description: Cap on this application's log files. The oldest rolled files go first. 0 means no cap.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.min-free-disk
properties.description: File logging pauses below this much free disk. 0 disables the check.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.scope
properties.description: shared also cleans up after dead instances. own touches only this instance's files.

properties.name: logchi.file.retention.check-interval
properties.description: How often retention runs.

properties.name: logchi.file.async.enabled
properties.description: Writes files on a background thread.

properties.name: logchi.file.async.queue-size
properties.description: Events buffered per file.

properties.name: logchi.file.async.drop-below
properties.description: When the queue is nearly full, events at or below this level are dropped. WARN and ERROR are never dropped.

properties.name: logchi.file.async.flush-timeout
properties.description: How long shutdown waits for queued events.

properties.name: logchi.levels
properties.description: Copies a level to its own file with its own retention. 'error' is on by default.

properties.name: logchi.channels
properties.description: Named logs from Channels.get(name), each with its own file and retention.

properties.name: logchi.mask.enabled
properties.description: Removes secrets from logs.

properties.name: logchi.mask.use-defaults
properties.description: Includes the built-in sensitive keys such as password and token.

properties.name: logchi.mask.cards
properties.description: Masks numbers that pass the card number check.

properties.name: logchi.mask.keys
properties.description: Extra sensitive keys, added to the built-in ones.

properties.name: logchi.mask.patterns
properties.description: Extra regular expressions to mask.

properties.name: logchi.mask.replacement
properties.description: Text that replaces a secret.

properties.name: logchi.context.enabled
properties.description: Adds request context to every log line.

properties.name: logchi.context.trace-id
properties.description: Adds a trace id per request.

properties.name: logchi.context.header
properties.description: Header the trace id is read from and returned in.

properties.name: logchi.context.user-id
properties.description: principal, header:<name> or none.

properties.name: logchi.context.extra-headers
properties.description: Headers to add to the context. X-Tenant-Id becomes tenantId.

properties.name: logchi.context.order
properties.description: Position of logchi's request filter among servlet or WebFlux filters. Lower runs earlier.

properties.name: logchi.logged.enabled
properties.description: Activates @Logged.

properties.name: logchi.logged.level
properties.description: Level of @Logged entry and exit lines.

properties.name: logchi.logged.slow-level
properties.description: Level of the exit line of a slow call.

properties.name: logchi.logged.error-level
properties.description: Level of the line logged when a method throws.

properties.name: logchi.logged.slower-than
properties.description: Default slow threshold, such as 1s, for @Logged without its own.

properties.name: logchi.logged.max-arg-length
properties.description: Longest rendered argument or result. 0 means no limit.
